svg.text: Home Budget: how a click reaches the database
The renderer only calls window.api; each call crosses the preload bridge as a 'domain:action' channel to a thin handler and its service.
Each arrow is one window.api call: preload invokes the channel, the handler unpacks the arguments and calls a service.
Errors travel back as codes (e.g. PDF_EXPORT_FAILED) and the renderer shows them as error.* text.
Zoom (window.api.zoom) uses webFrame inside the preload, with no IPC.
onNotificationOpen listens for main's notification:open event, sent when a Windows toast is clicked.
